cues.text: Hello, Linda speaking.
cues.speaker: LINDA

cues.text: Oh hi, Linda. This is Matt Brooks. Alex White gave me your number. He said you’d be able to give me some advice about moving to Banford.
cues.speaker: MATT

cues.text: Yes, Alex did mention you. How can I help?
cues.speaker: LINDA

cues.text: Well, first of all – which area to live in?
cues.speaker: MATT

cues.text: Well, I live in Dalton, which is a really nice suburb – not too expensive, and there’s a nice park.
cues.speaker: LINDA

cues.text: Sounds good. Do you know how much it would be to rent a two bedroom flat there?
cues.speaker: MATT

cues.text: Yeah, you should be able to get something reasonable for 850 pounds per month. That’s what people typically pay. You certainly wouldn’t want to pay more than 900 pounds. That doesn’t include bills or anything.
cues.speaker: LINDA

cues.text: No. That sound alright. I’ll definitely have a look there. Are the transport links easy from where you live?
cues.speaker: MATT

cues.text: Well, I’m very lucky. I work in the city centre so I don’t have to use public transport. I go by bike.
cues.speaker: LINDA

cues.text: Oh, I wish I could do that. Is it safe to cycle around the city?
cues.speaker: MATT

cues.text: Yes, it’s fine. And it keeps me fit. Anyway, driving to work in the city centre would be a nightmare because there’s hardly any parking. And the traffic during the rush hour can be bad.
cues.speaker: LINDA

cues.text: I’d be working from home but I’d have to go to London one or two days a week.
cues.speaker: MATT

cues.text: Oh, that’s perfect. Getting to London is no problem. There’s a fast train every 30 minutes which only takes 45 minutes.
cues.speaker: LINDA

cues.text: That’s good.
cues.speaker: MATT

cues.text: Yeah, the train service isn’t bad during the week. And they run quite late at night. It’s weekends that are a problem. They’re always doing engineering work and you have to take a bus to Hadham and pick up the train there, which is really slow. But other than that, Banford’s a great place to live. I’ve never been happier.
cues.speaker: LINDA

cues.text: There are some nice restaurants in the city centre and a brand new cinema which has only been open a couple of months. There’s a good arts centre too.
cues.speaker: LINDA

cues.text: Sounds like Banford’s got it all.
cues.speaker: MATT

cues.text: Yes! We’re really lucky. There are lots of really good aspects to living here. The schools are good and the hospital here is one of the best in the country. Everyone I know who’s been there’s had a positive experience. Oh, I can give you the name of my dentist too in Bridge Street, if you’re interested. I’ve been going to him for years and I’ve never had any problems.
cues.speaker: LINDA

cues.text: Oh, OK. Thanks!
cues.speaker: MATT

cues.text: I’ll find his number and send it to you.
cues.speaker: LINDA

cues.text: Thanks, that would be really helpful.
cues.speaker: MATT

cues.text: Are you planning to visit Banford soon?
cues.speaker: LINDA

cues.text: Yes. My wife and I are both coming next week. We want to make some appointments with estate agents.
cues.speaker: MATT

cues.text: I could meet you if you like and show you around.
cues.speaker: LINDA

cues.text: Are you sure? We’d really appreciate that.
cues.speaker: MATT

cues.text: Either a Tuesday or Thursday is good for me, after 5.30.
cues.speaker: LINDA

cues.text: Thursday’s preferable – Tuesday I need to get home before 6 pm.
cues.speaker: MATT

cues.text: Okay great. Let me know which train your catching and I’ll meet you in the cafe outside. You can’t miss it. It’s opposite the station and next to the museum.
cues.speaker: LINDA

cues.text: Brilliant. I’ll text you next week then. Thanks so much for all the advice.
cues.speaker: MATT

cues.text: No problem. I’ll see you next week.
cues.speaker: LINDA
